title: Vesper and the Protocol
author: August Thornbury
blurb: Silas Brightwater, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
